hypothesis: A small number of explicitly supervised coarse-to-fine groups can create genuine scale semantics without the full-generation tax of 64-way random-prefix reconstruction; additive DoG supervision may create stronger innovation semantics than cumulative targets alone.

pyramid.type: periodic Fourier Gaussian low-pass with telescoping adjacent differences
pyramid.endpoint: the zero-sigma final target is the input exactly, so the DoG residuals telescope losslessly
pyramid.sampling: one group is sampled uniformly per hierarchy example; 128 randomly positioned examples from each shuffled batch of 512 receive hierarchy supervision
pyramid.jitter: full and grouped decodes share the same latent-RMS-scaled sigma-0.05 noise realization

cumulative.objective: MSE between the sampled prefix reconstruction and its cumulative Gaussian low-pass target

innovation.objective: MSE between adjacent prefix-decoder increments and the matching telescoping DoG residual

calibration.note: large frozen-control scalar ratios reflect deliberately mismatched unordered prefix outputs; gradient calibration controls intervention strength

mechanism_gate.role: diagnostic and block-causal follow-up gate, not full-generation selection
mechanism_gate.cumulative: mean cumulative-target MSE improves by at least 25% from the control
mechanism_gate.innovation: mean innovation-target MSE improves by at least 25% and mean innovation cosine exceeds the control
mechanism_gate.visual: source, six targets, and six prefix reconstructions on fixed CIFAR test examples

selection.advance_5k_to_10k: candidate FID improves, is within 2 points of control, or FID/KID disagree
selection.replication_gate: 10k FID improves by at least 2 points and KID also improves
selection.block_causal_followup: targeted mechanism gate passes and 10k FID is no worse than 2 points above control
selection.combination_policy: do not add a causal mask, tokenwise noise schedule, radial reconstruction term, or LPIPS in this screen

verification.launch_retry: initial supervisor start failed before process creation because launcher executable bits were absent; fixed in commit 0c45336 and no GPU or experiment state was consumed
